title: Paper Moon
author: Rehana Munir
blurb: Be honest! Haven't we all dreamed of opening our own little bookshop? Well, Fiza gets the chance to turn that dream into reality. But between setting up shop, a mysterious customer, an ex-boyfriend, and the little complications of life, things aren't quite as simple as they seem. Get ready for a charming journey filled with books, Bombay, new beginnings, and a few little heartbreaks.
